d: Long, flowing platinum blonde hair with a heart-shaped curl atop the head, long side-swept bangs, and two small tufts of hair framing the face. Sharp, almond-shaped eyes in a bright cerulean blue. An adolescent appearance with a slender build. Wearing a white and magenta dress with gold trim, paired with dark brown thigh-high stockings and white boots. Features long, pointed elf ears, a gold tiara, and a large, ornate gold-and-black harp.
